title: Spot double charges
summary: Flag payments that repeat the same customer and amount within 10 minutes.
prompt: A retry bug in checkout sometimes charges a card twice. Flag likely duplicates for refund review.
A payment is a **duplicate** when the same customer's **previous** payment of the **same amount** happened at
most 10 minutes (600 seconds) earlier. "Previous" is in `paid_at` order, ties broken by `id`; two payments in
the same second count (the higher id is the duplicate). A triple charge gives two rows: the 2nd against the 1st,
Table: `payments(id, customer_id, amount_cents, paid_at)`, `paid_at` is `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`;
setup: CREATE TABLE payments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, paid_at TEXT NOT NULL);
solution: CAST(strftime('%s', paid_at) AS INTEGER) AS t,
LAG(CAST(strftime('%s', paid_at) AS INTEGER)) OVER w AS prev_t
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id, amount_cents ORDER BY paid_at, id)
SELECT id AS duplicate_id, prev_id AS original_id, customer_id, amount_cents, t - prev_t AS seconds_apart
WHERE prev_id IS NOT NULL AND t - prev_t <= 600;
wrong: SELECT b.id AS duplicate_id, a.id AS original_id, a.customer_id, a.amount_cents,
CAST(strftime('%s', b.paid_at) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', a.paid_at) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_apart
FROM payments a
JOIN payments b ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id AND b.amount_cents = a.amount_cents
AND b.paid_at > a.paid_at
AND CAST(strftime('%s', b.paid_at) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', a.paid_at) AS INTEGER) <= 600;
WITH p AS (
SELECT id, customer_id, amount_cents, CAST(strftime('%s', paid_at) AS INTEGER) AS t,
LAG(id) OVER w AS prev_id, LAG(CAST(strftime('%s', paid_at) AS INTEGER)) OVER w AS prev_t
FROM payments
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id, amount_cents ORDER BY paid_at, id)
SELECT id AS duplicate_id, prev_id AS original_id, customer_id, amount_cents, t - prev_t AS seconds_apart
FROM p WHERE prev_id IS NOT NULL AND t - prev_t < 600;
WITH p AS (
SELECT id, customer_id, amount_cents, CAST(strftime('%s', paid_at) AS INTEGER) AS t,
LAG(id) OVER w AS prev_id, LAG(CAST(strftime('%s', paid_at) AS INTEGER)) OVER w AS prev_t
FROM payments
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY paid_at, id)
SELECT id AS duplicate_id, prev_id AS original_id, customer_id, amount_cents, t - prev_t AS seconds_apart
FROM p WHERE prev_id IS NOT NULL AND t - prev_t <= 600;
hints: Compare each payment only with the one right before it for the same customer and amount: `LAG(...) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, amount_cents ORDER BY paid_at, id)`.
A self-join on 'any earlier payment within 10 minutes' pairs the 3rd charge with the 1st too; LAG pairs it only with the 2nd.
Take `LAG(id)` and `LAG(seconds)` in a CTE, then keep rows where the difference is at most 600.
